name: Gaia Hand 20

makers.name: Shenzhen Interstellar Lightyear Technology Co., Ltd.

summary: Gaia Hand 20 is Stella-Robot's modular dexterous-hand platform for embodied AI development. The manufacturer's August 2025 launch description specifies 16 active and four passive degrees of freedom, a biomimetic thumb and replaceable joint modules built around in-house micro-actuators. The hand is listed at approximately 790 g, with support for Isaac Sim and MuJoCo workflows. Sensing varies by edition: the base model focuses on motion control, Pro adds three-dimensional fingertip force sensing, and Ultra adds full-palm tactile arrays. description.en: Gaia Hand 20 is Stella-Robot's modular dexterous-hand platform for embodied AI development. The manufacturer's August 2025 launch description specifies 16 active and four passive degrees of freedom, a biomimetic thumb and replaceable joint modules built around in-house micro-actuators. The hand is listed at approximately 790 g, with support for Isaac Sim and MuJoCo workflows. Sensing varies by edition: the base model focuses on motion control, Pro adds three-dimensional fingertip force sensing, and Ultra adds full-palm tactile arrays. These editions should be distinguished when comparing capabilities.

sources.title: Gaia Hand 20 official launch announcement
sources.quote: 2025-08-07 10:33 Stella Robot 做具身智能，苦“高自由度灵巧手”久矣？ 从“运动学验证”走向“多模态感知操作”，研发团队往往要在脆弱的硬件、繁琐的维护和昂贵的成本之间反复妥协。灵巧手，似乎总是那个拖慢进度的“昂贵消耗品”。 今天，星际光年正式交出了一份破局的答卷—— 面向具身智能的通用型灵巧手开发平台：Gaia Hand 20 系列，正式发售！
